title: Ordering Question Schema
description: Arrange tiles into the correct order. items[i] is the correct tile at position i; distractors are extra tiles that should not be placed.

sourceText.description: The original sentence or passage shown for context (the correct ordering when items are joined).

items.description: Tiles in their correct order. items[i] is the correct tile at position i.

distractors.description: Extra tiles that should not be placed (decoys). Optional.

scoringMode.description: Scoring policy hint. 'strict' = exact-order match (all-or-nothing); 'kendall' = partial credit via Kendall tau distance over the learner's permutation. If omitted, consumers SHOULD default to 'strict' for orderingUnit: 'word' (where pairwise inversions don't have pedagogical meaning — a sentence either reads correctly or it doesn't) and 'kendall' for orderingUnit: 'sentence' or 'paragraph' (where partial credit reflects partial understanding of the discourse structure). Consumers that don't support partial credit MAY collapse 'kendall' to 'strict'.

orderingUnit.description: Display granularity hint for each tile relative to the source text. 'word' typically renders as inline tokens (sentence unscrambling); 'sentence' and 'paragraph' typically render as stacked card blocks (process-narrative reordering, essay-paragraph reordering). Consumers MAY render uniformly regardless; the field is advisory, not normative.
